note: A fix round that answers done and records nothing new (the record did not grow) is counted per PR head on the hub record (.nothing_new). At this many in a row on one head the park is PARKED: one alert and one event, and br_fix_remote queues no round again on that head until the PR's live head moves. 0 = off: every nothing-new round is re-offered next tick, as before.
